paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Pinchas, remez 782, according to Otzar Yisrael; Hyman says he has not found him in his Yalkut.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Chiyya bar Chama reporting Rabbi Levi. This supports the local full title. Hyman’s statement that he did not find the reference in his Yalkut remains his historical observation, and his Otzar Yisrael report remains attributed; the present digital match does not establish the contents of his particular copy.
